title: Lockheed Skunk Works and the UFO topic: Ben Rich, Rob Weiss, and the DeLonge emails
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lockheed Skunk Works and the UFO topic: Ben Rich, Rob Weiss, and the DeLonge emails, about 2016-2017 at Lockheed Martin Skunk Works, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ben Rich who's the president of Skunk Works their most secretive division used to call UFOs unfunded opportunities

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Ben Rich, a former president of Skunk Works, the most secretive division of the defence company Lockheed Martin, used to call UFOs "unfunded opportunities." Michels connects this to emails from 2016 and 2017, published by WikiLeaks, a site that releases leaked documents, which involve a Skunk Works figure named Rob Weiss and the musician and UFO advocate Tom DeLonge. He tells it because it would suggest the company has a real, quiet interest in UFOs.
